title: Transaction Monitoring Scenario Design
summary: Translate a risk hypothesis into a fully specified, reproducible monitoring rule, with temporal semantics, evidence gates, suppression boundaries and populated acceptance tests.
audience: Monitoring analysts, scenario owners, data owners and independent control reviewers
decision: Does the proposed rule implement its stated hypothesis without ambiguous fields, boundary behavior, exclusions or delivery decisions?
report_sections: Risk hypothesis, source scope and design boundary
Window outcomes, delivery and acceptance evidence
Limitations, quality gates and human authorization

domain_tables.name: EventLedger
domain_tables.title: Full fictional rule acceptance source

event_id.description: Immutable synthetic source-event identifier. It survives window expansion and may occur in several window membership lists without becoming another economic event.

account_id.description: Fictional account key at the declared grain. Account and customer are different units; no aggregation across accounts occurs without an explicit bridge.

event_utc.description: Timezone-aware economic event instant serialized in UTC. The source-local representation belongs in evidence; elapsed comparisons use this instant.

direction.description: Canonical CREDIT or DEBIT from the account perspective. Amount remains nonnegative; do not infer direction from a signed display string.

amount.description: Known nonnegative monetary amount in the row currency. Null means unrecovered source value and blocks the relevant completeness proposition.

currency.description: Explicit row currency. USD and EUR remain separate; the specimen contains no foreign-exchange conversion or implicit base-currency amount.

ownership_state.description: Evidence-backed own/external classification for the specific leg and historical period. Unknown ownership is not automatically external or own.

posting_state.description: Canonical posting status that determines whether a leg enters the declared posted population. A pending item remains visible outside that population.

evidence_ids.description: Semicolon-delimited exact Evidence keys. Every key must resolve, support the row proposition and retain its claim class and scope limitation.

domain_tables.title: Ordered deterministic rule predicates
rows: Reject relevant missing amount, time, identity or uncovered interval

predicate_id.description: Unique predicate identifier within the versioned rule. Its declared order controls precedence for blocking defects, exclusions and numeric comparisons.

order.description: Positive integer evaluation precedence. Numeric predicates cannot override an earlier relevant data-completeness failure.

field_or_measure.description: Exact input field or derived quantity being tested. A business phrase without a computable field mapping does not satisfy this contract.

operator.description: Literal comparison or grouping operation. Inclusive, strict and interval comparisons are deliberately different and must remain explicit.

operand.description: Complete threshold, interval or category against which the predicate compares. Monetary values include currency and durations include elapsed units.

null_result.description: Required branch when input cannot be evaluated. A null-sensitive predicate may block a window rather than defaulting to false or zero.

purpose.description: Bounded reason for the predicate and the mechanism it tests. This is an authored design rationale rather than a legal requirement.

evidence_ids.description: Semicolon-delimited exact Evidence keys. Every key must resolve, support the row proposition and retain its claim class and scope limitation.

domain_tables.name: WindowResults
domain_tables.title: Full anchored calculations and truth states

window_id.description: Stable account/anchor/specification window key. It distinguishes overlapping observations so a membership count cannot be mistaken for unique transactions.

account_id.description: Fictional account key at the declared grain. Account and customer are different units; no aggregation across accounts occurs without an explicit bridge.

anchor_event_id.description: Source eligible credit that starts the specified closed 24-hour window. Same-account membership is explicit and independently reproducible.

start_utc.description: Inclusive UTC instant at the anchor. The applicable window convention determines endpoint inclusion, not the date formatting of the rendered table.

end_utc.description: UTC endpoint exactly 24 elapsed hours after the anchor. The scenario-design closed interval includes this instant; the TM diagnostic convention matches it.

event_ids.description: Semicolon-delimited source-event membership in the specific window. Recompute the union separately before calculating unique population movement.

credit_total.description: Known eligible or gross credit subtotal as specified by the table grain. It is not necessarily a complete total when coverage_state or population_status is defective.

debit_total.description: Known eligible debit subtotal at the table grain. Null is required for a window total dependent on an unknown debit; known subtotals elsewhere remain explicitly partial.

ratio.description: Unrounded window debit-to-credit ratio. Null indicates a missing component or no positive denominator; comparisons occur before display rounding.

first_debit_hours.description: Elapsed hours from anchor to first strictly subsequent eligible debit. Null means no qualifying ordered pair; a contemporaneous debit cannot satisfy the predicate.

coverage_state.description: Completeness state for the exact account/window inputs. COMPLETE, BOUNDARY_INCOMPLETE and AMOUNT_UNKNOWN cannot be collapsed into a binary risk score.

rule_result.description: Deterministic raw result under the named specification: MATCH, NO_MATCH, EXCLUDED or NOT_ASSESSABLE. Contextual evidence does not rewrite it.

evidence_ids.description: Semicolon-delimited exact Evidence keys. Every key must resolve, support the row proposition and retain its claim class and scope limitation.

domain_tables.grain: one account, eligible credit anchor, currency and rule version

delivery_id.description: Unique proposal for a window delivery disposition. The record is separate from the raw match so grouping cannot hide a numerical result.

window_id.description: Stable account/anchor/specification window key. It distinguishes overlapping observations so a membership count cannot be mistaken for unique transactions.

raw_result.description: Preserved deterministic rule result before human review or delivery grouping. Explanations and grouping decisions must not delete or change it.

delivery_state.description: Proposed route for a raw outcome: review, no delivery or data repair. It describes the analytical queue decision without performing an external action.

group_id.description: Stable proposed delivery-group identifier. Null means the window produces no review group; grouping never erases the underlying result.

reason.description: Specific evidence-backed reason for a state or transition. It identifies the relevant row, rule or missing fact rather than a generic compliance label.

human_approval.description: Evidence of authorized approval for a design or delivery treatment. NOT_RECORDED is not interchangeable with approved or presumed approved.

known_credit_total.description: Sum of readable credits only at the declared stage, account or observed diagnostic window. The word known is substantive where an unresolved amount exists.

coverage_outcome.description: Account-level outcome that retains excluded and blocked accounts alongside assessed accounts. No-record output is not an acceptable substitute.

report_narrative: The authored credit-anchored rule yields two raw matching windows, three complete nonmatching windows and one blocked window. Its specification can be reviewed, but deployment authorization is absent.

The complete fictional source covers Sep 01, 2026 12:00 AM ET to Sep 03, 2026 12:00 AM ET exclusive. Thirteen events cover six accounts. M is retained as a confirmed own-transfer exclusion; O has one unknown amount.
J and K meet the exact authored predicates. L fails at an unrounded .899998 ratio even though one-decimal percentage display rounds to 90.0%. N fails strict temporal ordering. O requires data repair.

PredicateSpec fixes data completeness, posting and ownership eligibility, closed 24-hour credit-anchored windows, inclusive USD 5000 and .90 thresholds, strict subsequent-debit timing, and limited exact-set delivery grouping. EventLedger retains every source event.

WindowResults contains six windows and thirteen membership entries over eleven distinct external events. AccountCoverage retains the excluded M account. DeliveryDecisions retains raw states and no human approval. AcceptanceTests records arithmetic checks separately from unrecorded authorization.
All subject facts are fictional and located in file 10. Public FFIEC and Wolfsberg references support control-design context and do not endorse these parameters.
Repair E13; review rule scope, intended risks and untested mechanics; obtain an actual design decision. Do not automatically send alerts, change thresholds or apply suppression.
Known gross movement is $54,699.99, with E13 unknown. No production performance, complete monetary coverage, institutional approval or customer conclusion is established.
conclusion: The authored credit-anchored rule yields two raw matching windows, three complete nonmatching windows and one blocked window. Its specification can be reviewed, but deployment authorization is absent.
